note: The initial transparency request yielded RGB checkerboard imagery; selected deliverables use a generated cyan export matte followed by repository alpha extraction. No interior hue or opacity edits are applied.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Repaint the SEED stage for the same Rose line. Reference 1 is the current warm teardrop-shaped Rose seed; preserve its simple recognizable warm-brown seed identity. Reference 2 supplies the Rose line's tactile matte storybook gouache paintwork and softly warm upper-right light. Make one compact seed with rounded lower end, gently pointed upper-right tip, softly faceted cinnamon and golden-tan husk, and a tiny natural crack along its upper seam. A pinhead glimpse of pale fresh green inside that crack suggests life, but there must be no protruding shoot, root or leaf. Keep the husk pattern sparse and painterly, not shiny, metallic, deeply ridged or photorealistic. A firm rounded bottom is the ground contact; no dangling point or hanging stem. Strong simple value shapes must read at a 36-pixel icon and on grass, snow, or dark green backgrounds.
One isolated seed only on a square 1254×1254 high-resolution canvas. Center the seed horizontally, gently tilted towards the upper right, with a compact silhouette roughly 45% canvas width by 43% height. Place its lowest ground-contact point around x50% y90%. Leave generous clear margins. Fill all empty space with absolutely flat uniform bright cyan RGB 0,255,255 (#00FFFF) removable technical matte. Keep all painted seed interiors completely opaque and the edge crisp and clean. No checkerboard, gradient background, cyan rim, transparency effect inside the seed, soil, mound, pot, grass, shadow, contact shadow, ground line, scenery, roots, extra seed, magic glow, text or watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Repaint the SPROUT stage of Anki Garden's Rose line. Reference 1 is the old sprout and supplies its simple two-leaf identity; reference 2 supplies the new Rose line's matte storybook gouache paintwork and botanical leaf colors. Create one small upright lively seedling with a short sturdy green stem, two rounded slightly unequal cotyledons opening left and right, and one small newly emerging serrated rose leaf between/above them. The tiny true leaf should visibly connect this sprout to the later Rose foliage. No woody branches, buds, blooms or roots. Keep the small silhouette compact and clearly different from both a seed and a tall juvenile cane. Use warm sage/olive greens, cool teal shaded planes, gentle warm upper-right light, soft opaque painted texture and strong simple value shapes. Avoid detailed veins and dark outlines.
One isolated complete plant on a square 1254×1254 high-resolution canvas. The broad pair of leaves spans about 50% canvas width and the short stem plus leaves about 48% canvas height. Center root contact at x50% y92%, leaving ample empty space above and at both sides. Plant interiors are fully opaque. Every empty area is a flat uniform bright cyan RGB 0,255,255 (#00FFFF) technical matte, with clean crisp cutout boundaries. No checkerboard, gradient, cyan rim, translucent leaves, soil, pot, ground shadow, ground line, scenery, sparkles, effects, text or watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Derive the YOUNG juvenile stage of the same Rose line as the referenced Flowering plant. Match its warm matte storybook gouache, sage/olive serrated rose leaves, cool teal shadow planes, softly warm upper-right lighting, brown-green woody stem and slightly asymmetrical organic growth. This is a slender juvenile plant, not a full shrub: one central upright cane with two short side branches, three to four compact groups of substantial rose leaves and exactly one small closed coral-pink bud at the top. Keep clear open spaces, a sturdy visible central stem, and simplified leaf groups that read in a 36-pixel icon. Its silhouette should be notably narrower and sparser than Mature but feel lively and established. No open flowers. Do not carry over the large flowering canopy.
One complete isolated plant on a square high-resolution 1254×1254 canvas. The entire plant is comfortably centered, about 48% canvas width and 75% canvas height, root contact at x50% y92%, all margins at least 6%. Solid opaque paint inside every leaf, stem and bud; clean crisp antialiased cutout edges. Fill all empty space, including small enclosed gaps, with a uniform flat bright cyan RGB 0,255,255 (#00FFFF) technical matte. No checkerboard, background gradient, cyan outline, translucent foliage, ground shadow, soil, pot, ground line, exposed roots, floating petals, effects, text, border or watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Derive the Mature growth stage of the SAME Rose plant from reference 1, the new Flowering identity master. Reference 2 is the previous Mature stage and supplies only the idea of several closed buds. Match reference 1's tactile matte storybook gouache, medium sage/olive rose leaves, cool teal shaded planes, soft warm upper-right light, woody branching structure and centered root crown.
This is the stage immediately before flowering: a vigorous upright rose shrub with three main canes spreading into a naturally asymmetrical fan, several secondary branches, broad readable groups of serrated rose leaves, and seven prominent closed coral-pink rose buds at the branch tips. Absolutely no open flowers. Buds should be large enough to read as a distinct promise of flowering in a 36-pixel icon. The shrub should feel taller, fuller and more established than a juvenile single cane while clearly less abundant than the flowering master. Keep organic gaps between leaf groups; avoid an indistinct ball of tiny leaves. Petals, leaves and stems must be fully solid foreground. Keep the paintwork calm and matte, no glossy highlights, no outlines, no excessive micro-veins.
One complete isolated plant, centered square 1254×1254 export composition, root contact at x50% y93%, at least 5% clear margins, overall upright silhouette roughly 72% width and 83% height. Flat uniform bright cyan RGB 0,255,255 (#00FFFF) technical matte throughout all empty space and enclosed gaps. No checkerboard, cyan fringe or colored rim, translucent interiors, ground shadow, soil, pot, scenery, exposed roots, floating petals, effects, text, watermark or border.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: Flowering stage of the Rose plant in Anki Garden, a professional cozy video game sprite. Repaint the referenced Rose to improve its silhouette and small-icon readability while preserving its warm storybook gouache identity. The reference is the existing Flowering artwork, not a background to retain. Produce one single rose shrub only on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, square high-resolution canvas. Replace the magenta background with real transparency. Every leaf, stem, bud and petal interior must be fully opaque; transparency belongs only to empty space and clean antialiased boundaries.
Art direction: tactile matte gouache, softly varied pigment, restrained hand-painted detail, medium sage/olive botanical greens with cool teal shaded planes and gentle warm upper-right light. A naturally asymmetrical upright branching shrub, thin woody stems joining one centered root crown. Around seven clearly readable open coral-pink rose rosettes in three loosely grouped clusters, with a few closed buds; varied flower sizes with curled layered rose petals, no excessive frills. Create broader leaf groups and strong simple value shapes that still read at 36-pixel icons. Keep the foliage comfortably visible on dark green and moonlit blue as well as snow and golden grass; use natural value separation, no luminous outline. This is the penultimate growth stage, abundant but leaving room for a fuller and taller red-and-violet finale.
Composition: complete uncropped plant viewed straight on with the same mild garden perspective as the reference. Root contact centered at x=50%, y=93% of the canvas. Leave at least 4% clear margins on all sides, no exposed hanging roots. Overall crown approximately 75% of canvas width and 83% height, tapering to the root crown. No pot, planter, soil clump, scenery, horizon, ground line, cast shadow, contact shadow, floating petals, text, watermark, gold outlining, glossy surfaces, cyan/magenta fringe, black contour, or translucent foliage. Deliver a clean isolated production-quality plant, not a contact sheet.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Create the Full Bloom finale of the SAME Rose plant line. Reference image 1 is the new Flowering plant: its matte storybook gouache style, leaf shape, woody branching fan, root crown, camera and soft lighting are the primary identity to preserve. Reference image 2 is the OLD Full Bloom plant: borrow only its crimson-red and violet flower palette and a dominant upper red rose; do not copy its glossy gold tracing or sparse tree-like architecture.
Repaint a fuller, more abundant, slightly taller rose shrub with the same main branching structure as image 1. Approximately nine open rose blooms with varied sizes: one magnificent crimson upper-center hero rose, five smaller crimson/coral-red roses, and three medium-value plum-violet roses that remain readable against a dark green backdrop. Violet petals should have soft lavender painted highlights, never electric blue. The hero flower should be about one quarter of the overall canopy width, not half of the entire plant. A few closed buds, rich layered leaf groups, and two small crimson petals floating immediately beside the crown. Give this final stage more occupied foliage and flower mass than image 1; no thinning into bare branches. Retain medium sage/olive botanical greens, cool teal shaded planes, tactile opaque matte paint, gentle warm upper-right illumination, restrained warm gold touches on a few petal tips only. No metallic veins, glossy finish, gold outline on every petal, glowing aura, neon fringe or black contour.
Export composition: one complete isolated plant, square high-resolution image, upright asymmetrical shrub viewed straight on, root contact centered x50% y93%, at least 4% clear margin, crown roughly 80% canvas width by 84% height. Background must be flat bright cyan RGB 0,255,255 (#00FFFF) across all empty space and every enclosed gap, with clean crisp cutout edges. Cyan is only a removable technical matte, never mixed into the plant. Plant interiors opaque. No checkerboard, gradient background, scenery, pot, soil, ground shadow, ground line, text or watermark.

Edit only the background of this supplied Rose Flowering sprite. Keep every part of the plant pixel-faithful in shape, color, petal count, foliage detail, position and size. Remove the entire gray-and-white checkerboard, including every little enclosed gap between leaves, stems and flowers. Replace it with an absolutely uniform, flat, opaque RGB (0,255,255), hex #00FFFF cyan background. This cyan is a technical export matte, not part of the plant. No checkerboard, gradient, shadow, white halo, cyan glow or cyan outline; maintain crisp clean boundaries between botanical colors and the flat cyan. Petals, buds, leaves and stems must be solid painted foreground with no holes or translucent interiors. Keep the square 1254 by 1254 composition and margins. Do not redesign, recolor, add or remove any part of the plant.
